feature: Strategy focus, PRs 3 and 4b: the strategy block on Analysis, and Suggested changes aiming at the focus
note: Needs ANALYSIS_TAB_ENABLED and STRATEGY_FOCUS_ENABLED 'true' (and TUNING_ENABLED for the tools below it), on a scratch branch off local-dev migrated past 0172, as the audit account. The block draws only over a reading, so each deck must have been analyzed. SF_NOFOCUS_DECK: an analyzed deck with no focus (HD - Brago). SF_FOCUS_DECK: an analyzed deck with a focus set in its top five (HD - Elves, strategy_focus 'typal:Elf'). SF_PENDING_DECK: an analyzed, committed deck with a focus and cards toward it added since the commit (HD Tune - Blood Rites). The empty states (none, tooSmall) and a focus outside the top five are held by strategy-block.test.tsx: a deck under 30 nonland cannot hold a reading. PR 4b adds two rows on SF_FOCUS_DECK (HD - Elves, focus typal:Elf): SC-ready, Suggested changes opened with the focus row and the lead sentence, before a run; and SC-results, that run reopened from History (one real call on the scratch branch, about a cent, made beforehand), with the dashed focus chip on additions toward the focus, the off-plan chip on cuts and focus Elves in the read-from line.
